changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql:
IF (NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'api' AND TABLE_NAME = 'ExecutionMetric')) BEGIN CREATE TABLE [api].[ExecutionMetric]( ExecutionID uniqueidentifier NOT NULL, ItemNumber int NOT NULL, AssetUid uniqueidentifier NOT NULL, MetricAssetUid uniqueidentifier NOT NULL, EffectiveDate date NOT NULL, Result bit NOT NULL, IsValidAsset bit NULL, IsValidMetric bit NULL, IsValidMetricDate bit NULL, Message nvarchar(2500) NULL, Success bit NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_ApiExecutionMetric] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [ExecutionID] ASC, [ItemNumber] ASC ) );
CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IX_ApiExecutionMetric_AssetUid ON [api].[ExecutionMetric] ( AssetUid ASC ); CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IX_ApiExecutionMetric_MetricAssetUid ON [api].[ExecutionMetric] ( MetricAssetUid ASC ); CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IX_ApiExecutionMetric_Success ON [api].[ExecutionMetric] ( Success ASC ); END
changeSet.rollback: IF (EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'api' AND TABLE_NAME = 'ExecutionMetric')) BEGIN drop table [api].[ExecutionMetric] END
